scope: All19 fixed validation cells, then report7 harmed cells without selecting them for aggregate analysis
base: Saved F2/F3 predictions; no new inference or fitting

observable_tags.positive_slope20: OLS normalized-capacity slope over last20 completed cycles >0; local recovery pattern, not proof of mechanism
observable_tags.high_roughness_ratio: MAD(past19 one-cycle capacity changes)/max(abs(past20 slope),1e-6) >train-only cell-duration-weighted75th percentile
observable_tags.recent_decline_twice_previous: last20 and preceding20 slopes negative and last20<=2*preceding20

train_threshold: 52 training cells only, same event-only origin ranges and inverse within-cell duration weights; one descriptive threshold estimation, no predictive fit
aggregation: Original19-cell equal weights, each query weight1/Ncell; tag averages conditional on selected-query weights; do not renormalize each cell inside tag
interval_rule: Consecutive harm>0 for at least10 cycles; report same frozen rule all19cells
interpretation: Descriptive validation analysis only. No causal noise/phase attribution and no trained/picked update gate or heldout predictive reliability claim
